title: ranunculus aquatilis subsp. triphyllos
intro: Ranunculus aquatilis subsp. triphyllos, commonly known as Marsh Buttercup or Three-leaved Buttercup, is a plant species belonging to the family Ranunculaceae, characterized by its three-leafed structure and ability to thrive in aquatic environments. The health benefits of Ranunculus aquatilis subsp. triphyllos include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, although its effectiveness and safety for these purposes require further research. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus aquatilis subsp. triphyllos include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
